description: This file defines the EmployeeSubordinateAPI class, which manages API endpoints for handling subordinate employee data within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for listing, adding, updating, and deleting subordinate relationships, utilizing various services and models to process requests and responses.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee subordinate relationships, providing endpoints to list, add, update, and delete subordinates, and connecting to relevant services and models.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subordinates for a specific employee, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Adds a new subordinate relationship for an employee.

methods.name: setSubordinateParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for a subordinate report-to relationship based on request data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving subordinate lists, including employee number and sorting parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes subordinate relationships for a specified employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting subordinate relationships.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific subordinate relationship by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific subordinate relationship.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the reporting method for a subordinate relationship.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating subordinate relationships.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee and subordinate IDs from request URL attributes.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for employee number parameter.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for reporting method ID parameter.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdsRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for subordinate ID list.
